## Elaborated result

`flit_t` is a 23-bit packed struct: 13-bit payload + 8-bit tag + 2-bit flags ([top.sv:3](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/top.sv:3)). `data_i` width is `23 × NumChannels × NumPhysChannels`; `valid_i` width is `NumChannels × NumVirtChannels` ([floo_fifo.sv:19](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:19)).

| Instance | Effective `(channels, virt, phys; depth)` | `data_i` / `valid_i` width | Selected generate branch | Elaborated `cc_stream_fifo` / `floo_vc_arbiter` |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
| `u_virtual` | `(3, 4, 1; 5)` | 69 / 12 bits | `gen_floo_fifo.gen_virt_channels` | 12 / 3 |
| `u_physical` | `(2, 3, 3; 2)` | 138 / 6 bits | `gen_floo_fifo.gen_phys_channels` | 6 / 0 |
| `u_bypass` | `(2, 4, 1; 0)` | 46 / 8 bits | `gen_no_fifo` | 0 / 0 |

The overrides are at [top.sv:9](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/top.sv:9), [top.sv:14](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/top.sv:14), and [top.sv:19](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/top.sv:19). Generate precedence is: `FifoDepth == 0` selects `gen_no_fifo` first; otherwise `NumPhysChannels == 1` selects virtual-channel buffering; only otherwise is `NumVirtChannels == NumPhysChannels` tested for physical-channel buffering ([floo_fifo.sv:28](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:28)).

- Virtual `n=2, v=3` stream FIFO:
  `floo_config_top.u_virtual.gen_floo_fifo.gen_virt_channels.gen_channel[2].gen_virt_channel[3].i_stream_fifo`

  Effective `Depth=5`, `FallThrough=0`. Its direct source actuals are `data_i[n]` and `data_out[n][v]` ([floo_fifo.sv:52](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:52)). Here `n`/`v` are the source genvar spellings; this elaborated path corresponds to `data_i[2]` and `data_out[2][3]`.

- Physical `n=1, v=2` stream FIFO:
  `floo_config_top.u_physical.gen_floo_fifo.gen_phys_channels.gen_channel[1].gen_virt_channel[2].i_stream_fifo`

  Effective `Depth=2`. Its direct source actuals are `data_i[n][v]` and `data_o[n][v]` ([floo_fifo.sv:89](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:89)), corresponding to `data_i[1][2]` and `data_o[1][2]`.

For the virtual FIFO’s child:

`…gen_channel[2].gen_virt_channel[3].i_stream_fifo.fifo_i`

the pointer (`read_pointer_q`) is 3 bits, the status counter (`status_cnt_q`) is 3 bits, and packed `mem_q` is 115 bits (`data_t[4:0]`). `PtrWidth = idx_width(5) = ceil(log2(5)) = 3`; `UsageWidth = cnt_width(5) = idx_width(6) = 3` ([cc_fifo.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:43), [cc_pkg.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_pkg.sv:43)). `mem_q` has five 23-bit packed structured flits: `5 × (13 + 8 + 2) = 115` ([cc_fifo.sv:53](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:53)).

The `floo_fifo` declaration defaults are `(NumChannels, NumVirtChannels, NumPhysChannels, FifoDepth) = (2,1,1,1)` and `flit_t = logic` (one bit) ([floo_fifo.sv:8](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:8)). Those defaults do not describe any of the three integration instances above; all override the channel/depth values and use the 23-bit struct. Likewise, the stream FIFO’s nominal `DataWidth=32` is not the actual payload width here because its `data_t` is explicitly overridden to `flit_t`.

`clr_i` is not explicitly connected on either generated stream-FIFO template ([floo_fifo.sv:47](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:47), [floo_fifo.sv:84](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:84)); semantic inspection reports it unconnected on both selected instances. `flush_i` is explicitly tied low. Internally, `cc_stream_fifo` forwards `clr_i` to its defined `cc_fifo` child ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:50](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_stream_fifo.sv:50)), and `cc_fifo` uses it for pointer/counter and memory clearing ([cc_fifo.sv:120](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:120)). Thus the fragment establishes an unconnected clear input, not a known tied-low or asserted clear behavior. This is not due to an absent FIFO definition: both FIFO modules are present and the `cc_fifo` child elaborates.
